notes.title: First update now available!
notes.notes:
The first update to Doctor Flow is now available to play! With this update we tried to address the feedback we’ve received and improve the game in general. You can find a complete list of all the changes below. Happy diagnosing!

Gameplay

Added tooltips to further explain gameplay, tooltips can be turned off in the settings menu.
Added an indicator that shows how many patients have a certain disease. 
Increased patient count in all scenarios to make the limited accuracy tests fairer.
As a result, rebalanced all the scenario score requirements. Note that this resets the highscores, but your achieved star ratings won’t be changed. 
Reworked tests that have a limited accuracy to perform with an accuracy closer to what is listed, even for lower amounts of patients. 
Rebalanced disease distribution in scenarios where it was unintuitive. 


Interface

The last unfinished scenario is now automatically selected when opening the scenario select screen. 
Changed the default zoom level to be more zoomed out.
Scaled down UI and menu size to better match bigger screens.
General UI and menu improvements.


Other

Prevented the game from minimizing when it loses focus.
Added an option to limit the game’s framerate in the settings.

notes.title: Upcoming update: improving the flow.
notes.notes:
We really enjoyed the first responses to Doctor Flow! There were some nice responses but also some valuable feedback. We realized that there are still some issues in the game that prevent especially the hardcore puzzlers to enjoy the game. But we have some good news for you! The last few weeks we have been working hard on an update that will address the most pressing issues. You can expect some streamlining of the puzzles, an easier introduction for new players, and some general improvements to the game’s interface.

The new and improved Doctor Flow will be released this Friday, September 14th.
